title: AVSP: Fix FCS calculation
description:
AVSP TGen doesn't need to call add_ethernet_trailer. It should
call set_actual_length so that the ethertype dissector adds
the trailer (in add_dix_trailer). This way the FCS can actually
be correctly calculated over the entire frame, instead of on
the tvb in packet-avsp which doesn't include the Ethernet
addresses and the ethertype.

Fixes FCS calculation with the sample capture in !9048

Also, the FT_NONE hf_avsp_tgen_payload was not used. Assume
that this is suppose to be used for the tree header, instead
of hf_avsp_tgen_payload_data being added to the tree twice,
once for a header, and once displaying the bytes.
